summary: Tinder for dragons - now with 100% more story and puzzles!
description: BE WARNED. Part of the challenge is figuring out how to play. It's hard, but keep trying, and you'll master it. Good luck! CHANGE YOUR FATE, SOLVE PUZZLES, TRAIN A DRAGON - all within a reach of a card swipe! Unhatched is an absurdly peculiar mix of puzzle solving and role play, married together by a simple card swiping mechanic. It puts you into the role of a young dragon trainer. Swipe left or right through numerous puzzles and story events to reclaim your freedom. What starts innocently with opening a jar of pickles, will end up testing the limits of your wit and bond you create with your dragon! During your adventure you will collect cards and use them to duel mini-bosses controlled by the computer. It'll require mini deck building, carefull planning and a strategic approach. The game has no randomness so each time there is a solution. Each card in your deck can be swiped either left or right to have a different effect. AWARDS ⭐ Google Play Indie Games Festival 2020 - Finalist ⭐ ⭐ Independent Game Festival 2020 - Honorable Mention ⭐ ⭐ Imagine Cup Poland - Finalist ⭐ FEATURES + Story that unfolds based on your choices 🐉 + No randomness, solve every puzzle with skill only 🧩 + Mini deck building 🧱 + No ads, timers, or other freemium shenanigans 😍 + Portrait orientation for casual one-handed gameplay 👋 + Hand crafted campaign, 4 hours long 💪 + No internet connection required 🚫🌐 + Google Play integration 🎮 Unhatched is a collaboration between Filip (design/programming), Karol (art), and Filip Żegleń (music) Unhatched is available in English. If you run into a problem, please contact us at https://discord.gg/WfZFzv2 with as much information as possible on the issue. For more info, please visit http://unhatched-game.com
